name: XlPropertyDisplayedIn
description: Specifies where to display the property.

constants.name: xlDisplayPropertyInPivotTable
constants.description: Displays member property in the PivotTable only. This is the default value.

constants.name: xlDisplayPropertyInTooltip
constants.description: Displays member property in both the tooltip and the PivotTable.

constants.name: xlDisplayPropertyInPivotTableAndTooltip
constants.description: Displays member property in the tooltip only.
